	n, mod = map(int, input().split())
	if n == 1:
		print(0)
		return
	z = [1]
	aaa = 0
	for i in range(2,n+1):
		nz = [0]*((i-1)*i//2+1)
		d = [0]*(len(z)+1)
		for w in range(len(z)-1, -1, -1):

		R = len(z)

			bbb = (bbb + ((e[R] - e[L]) * (i+1+jj) \

		#print(bbb)
		aaa += (bbb * A(n,n-i)) % mod
		#print(nz)

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long factorial(int n) {
    long long res = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) res *= i;
    return res;
}

long long A(int n, int k) {
    return factorial(n) / factorial(n - k);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<long long> z(1, 1);
    long long aaa = 0;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        int size_nz = (i - 1) * i / 2 + 1;
        vector<long long> nz(size_nz, 0);
        vector<long long> d(z.size() + 1, 0);
        for (int w = (int)z.size() - 1; w >= 0; --w) {
            d[w] = (d[w + 1] + z[w]) % mod;
        }
        for (int w = 0; w < size_nz; ++w) {
            int L = max(0, w + 1 - i);
            int R = min((int)z.size() - 1, w);
            nz[w] = (d[L] - d[R + 1]) % mod;
            if (nz[w] < 0) nz[w] += mod;
        }
        vector<long long> e(d.size() + 1, 0);
        vector<long long> f(d.size() + 1, 0);
        for (size_t w = 0; w + 1 < e.size(); ++w) {
            e[w + 1] = (e[w] + d[w]) % mod;
            f[w + 1] = (f[w] - (long long)w * d[w]) % mod;
        }
        int R = (int)z.size();
        long long bbb = 0;
        for (int jj = max(0, (int)z.size() - i); jj < (int)z.size() - 1; ++jj) {
            int L = jj + 2;
            bbb = (bbb + (((e[R] - e[L]) % mod + mod) % mod) * (i + 1 + jj) % mod + ((f[R] - f[L]) % mod + mod) % mod) * z[jj] % mod;
        }
        for (int jj = 0; jj + i <= (int)z.size(); ++jj) {
            int L = jj + 2;
            int R2 = i + jj;
            bbb = (bbb + (((e[R2 + 1] - e[L]) % mod + mod) % mod) * (i + 1 + jj) % mod + ((f[R2 + 1] - f[L]) % mod + mod) % mod) * z[jj] % mod;
        }
        aaa = (aaa + bbb * A(n, n - i)) % mod;
        z = nz;
    }
    cout << aaa % mod << "\n";
    return 0;
}
